subject: Proof of hosting boundary and operator snapshot — Medalix pilot
messages:
From: Emma Langston <emma.langston@medalix.health>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medalix.health
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Residency/operator snapshot for EU pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Medalix is keen to move the pilot forward. As part of our information security intake we need a short packet to confirm the deployment boundary and operator controls for the EU-hosted private deployment. Specifically could you provide: 

- A diagram that shows the privatelink/VPC topology for the EU cluster (ingress/egress paths, peering endpoints, and the boundary where customer traffic is terminated).
- A redacted operator roster (names + roles + country) for any people that have console/operator access to EU nodes.
- Confirmation of KMS partitioning (ARE keys in an EU KMS partition or can keys traverse regions?).
- A pointer to the SOC 2 evidence index or a minimal list of artifacts we can expect in the SOC2 snapshot (control IDs we will receive).

If any of this needs to be redacted for privacy, a redaction-friendly CSV or XLSX is fine — we just need enough detail to accept the pilot in our EU corporate environment. Can you also indicate an ETA (business days)?

Best,
Emma
Medalix Security

---
Medalix internal note: Medalix is subject to EU-based data residency rules; pilot must have demonstrable operator locality and KMS separation.
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Langston <emma.langston@medalix.health>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Residency/operator snapshot for EU pilot

Emma,

Appreciate the clear list — we can get that over. Attached are two items we can share now: a first-pass privatelink topology (privatelink-diagram-v1.pdf) and a redacted operator snapshot (ops-snapshot-redacted.csv). The privatelink diagram highlights the EU ingress endpoint and the peering boundary; the roster file has roles and country only (no personal contact details).

KMS: short answer — customer data-encryption keys for the EU pilot are generated and stored in the EU KMS partition for the pilot tenant; we do not replicate those keys outside the partition. I'll add the definitive KMS partition doc to the packet once we confirm the minimal format you need.

SOC 2: the index we can supply is attached as soc2-snapshot-index.txt — it lists the control families we map to and indicates which artifacts are shareable (most are). We will avoid sending raw logs in this packet; if you need a sample audit-log extract we can provide one with truncated PII.

Next steps and ETA: Irène and Karthik are cc'd — Irène can prepare the sanitized operator roster and Karthik will confirm the diagram update and the KMS note. We expect to send the completed packet (diagram v2 + KMS partition statement + final roster) within 2 business days. If you need an expedited turnaround, let us know and we can prioritize.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: privatelink-diagram-v1.pdf (diagram, 1 page), ops-snapshot-redacted.csv (CSV, redacted), soc2-snapshot-index.txt (text index)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Residency/operator snapshot for EU pilot — action items

FYI forwarding Medalix ask and the packet I just sent. Action items: 

- Irene: please produce the final redacted operator roster. Required fields: role, operator scope (control-plane / infra / oncall), country, and whether MFA/HSM-backed key access is in use. Obfuscate user ids (we only need role-level granularity) — deliver as CSV.
- Karthik: update the privatelink diagram to call out the exact peering endpoint names and the KMS partition ID; include a one-paragraph KMS partition statement we can hand to the customer.

Timeline: Vanessa is promising final packet in ~2 business days; let's aim for EOD Thu 19 Nov 2026 PST. If either of you need more time, flag now.

Thanks — V.

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Langston <emma.langston@medalix.health> wrote:
> [original request omitted]

Vanessa,

Thank you — we received privatelink-diagram-v1.pdf and the ops-snapshot-redacted.csv. The level of role granularity looks fine. A couple of follow-ups before we close the intake: 

1) Can you confirm the KMS partition ID in writing (a single paragraph is sufficient) and whether key export is disabled for that partition?
2) We would like one sample of an access audit extract (30-line sample) showing operator console sessions and timestamps — truncated usernames are OK. Please redact any IP addresses.

If you can get those two items in the updated packet, our security intake team can sign the pilot off. ETA: would you be able to send by close of day Thursday (2026-11-19) so we can review on Friday?

Best,
Emma
Medalix Security

--
Medalix: This packet will be attached to our internal Supplier Acceptance checklist once we have the KMS paragraph + access sample.
